propositions: The bugfix-size attestation gate blocks any large bug fix (>150 non-test lines) reviewed and signed by a developer in an unpinned environment, because the keyring lookup returns None and triggers an affirmative 'mismatch' verdict in the not-pinned arm.

No executable path exists for a contributor to obtain an op-cert attestation acceptable to this gate, because the opcert service has no client in the repo, cannot persist signed envelopes, and the only pinned environment (prod) is unreachable to developers.

The gate rejects valid, signed, subject-bound plan-review attestations solely on signing environment provenance rather than on whether an actual review occurred, making it an anti-adversary gate that lacks a trust root contributors can satisfy.

The not-pinned arm's 'mismatch' classification and the requirement for pinned environment signatories render the criterion unsatisfiable for any locally-reviewed bug unless every developer is added to a CODEOWNERS-gated keyring.
